items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: The mention of Michael Colgrass is made by [MR. WILSON, JR.], not the interviewee [Teddy Wilson]. The interviewee does not speak about Colgrass.

ctx.x: The Alvin Ailey Ballet is considering doing some things. They did one of Mingus's things.

I'd just like to ask a question for anybody. First of all, today, I had one of the pleasures of my life. I saw my favorite orchestra, the Boston Symphony, playing in its own hall, which was just magnificent. Now they did a program that consisted of work by Michael Colgrass, a composer I know, that was done in 1977. Then they did one of

Haydn the Paris symphonies, which was from the 1780's, and they did something from the 1880's. Now that's quite a span, quite a spectrum of musical styles -- and all of them were done with extraordinary excellence. The orchestra was great, the conductor was great and so forth.
